messages:
rachel: FYI after the TS/Go client updates some tenants report odd quota spikes + dashboard gaps. looks like routing_policy payloads are inconsistent across client versions :thinking_face:
don: example?
rachel: older go client sends `routing_policy: null` for default, new TS sends `routing_policy: "default"` and some services send `routing_policy: []`
kevin: that will break attribution. console parsing expects a string tag or an array of tags; null/empty-array becomes unattributed
tara: can we map null -> ["default"] on ingest? short-term shim to avoid customer impact
kevin: yes, but let's be careful with batched requests where items have mixed shapes 
don: proposal: 1) ingest shim normalizes null/""/string/array to array; 2) add per-tenant metric `routing_shape_variant` and dashboard filter; 3) ship SDKs to emit canonical array and include a tiny migration WARN in vX.Y
rachel: agree. I'll add the dashboard tiles and an alert if >1% of tokens for a tenant are unattributed
ci-bot: deployment queued: ingress-normalize-shim -> 2026-03-22 09:30 PT, canary 5% (id: c-49777-norm)
kevin: i'll open TS + Go PRs today. tests will include single string, empty string, null, empty array, and mixed batch payloads
tara: after canary looks good, let's coordinate a short note for #devex + update migration docs. aim to remove shim in 2 weeks once telemetry shows <0.1% legacy shapes
don: thanks team. ping here when canary reaches 50% so we can flip console filters and finalize changelog blurb.
